items.q: asked him could him and Dayton, who was the trombone player, work with us those three days, and they said yes.

ctx.x: I was going to say... You said you called him, so telephones must have been out certainly.
Yeah, 1924. And asked him could him and Dayton, who was the trombone player, work with us those three days, and they said yes.
So you were 18 at that time.
